newsitem.title: FRANCE: French AFER life assurance 96 net return 6.84 pct.
newsitem.headline: French AFER life assurance 96 net return 6.84 pct.

text.p: The French savings and retirement association, AFER, said the net return on its life assurance contracts in 1996 fell to 6.84 percent from 7.44 percent the year before.

The grouping, which was founded in 1976 and whose yield is often taken as a market for the wider insurance industry, said at a press lunch that at end-1996 it had 112.7 billion francs under management versus 95.7 billion at the end of 1995.
The gross return in 1996 was 7.35 percent, it said in a statement issued at the lunch. Falling interest rates have diminished returns.
